[[Mamelodi Sundowns F.C.|Mamelodi Sundowns]] were the defending champions, having won the previous [[2015–16 South African Premier Division]] (PSL) season. The season featured 14 teams from the 2015–16 season and two new teams promoted from the [[2015–16 National First Division]]: [[Baroka F.C.|Baroka]] and [[Highlands Park F.C.|Highlands Park]] who replace relegated [[Jomo Cosmos F.C.|Jomo Cosmos]] and [[University of Pretoria F.C.|University of Pretoria]]. Highlands Park promotion was won via the [[2015–16 National First Division#Play-offs|PSL Playoff Tournament]]. [[Cape Town City F.C. (2016)|Cape Town City]] bought over the franchise of [[Mpumalanga Black Aces F.C.|Mpumalanga Black Aces]] and relocated from [[Mbombela Stadium]] to [[Cape Town Stadium]].{{cite web|title=Mpumalanga
